sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
வண்ணமலர் பல தொடுக்கும் நூல் போல்
எண்ணிலா பிறவியை கோர்ப்பதே ஆன்மா
sections.translit:
vaNNamalar pala thodukkum nUl pOl
eNNilA piRaviyai kOrppadhE AnmA
sections.en: Just as a string connects colorful flowers, so the soul connects the countless births of a human.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
பூக்கள் இணந்தே தோன்றினும் நூல் தனியல்லவோ
உடல் பலவொடு சேர்ந்திடும் ஆத்மா வேறல்லவோ
sections.translit:
pUkkaL iNaindhE thOndRinum nUl thaniyallavO
udal palavodu sErndhidum AthmA vERallavO
sections.en: Is it not true that a piece of string is independent, though flowers appear as a unit when woven together as a garland? Likewise, is it not true that the soul is separate, even as it links physical bodies across birth cycles?

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
பெரிதான மானிட ஜன்மத்தில் மறை கற்கும்
அரிதான வேளையிலே ப்ரம்ம நிலை வருகையிலே
பற்றி படரும் ஆசையின் அநித்யம் புரிகையிலே
பெற்றிடும் ஞான ஒளியிடை ஆத்மனைக் கண்டிடுவாய்
sections.translit:
peridhAna mAnida janmatthil maRai kaRkum
aridhAna vELaiyilE brahmma nilai varugaiyilE
patRi padarum Asaiyin anithyam purigaiyilE
petRidum nyAna OLiyidai Athmanaik kaNdiduvAy
sections.en: Find the soul and its source during the rare and precious period of learning the scriptures. These enlightening materials point to a path of righteousness in this unique human life.  A state of awakening hits you and realization sets in on the impermanence of spiraling desires. You receive illuminating knowledge from a higher power, and you traverse the correct path to reach the Source.

notes:
This song is based on the teachings and principles treasured in the Vivekachoodamani117.
Vivekacudamani of Sri Samkara Bhagavatpada with an English translation of the commentary in Sanskrit by  Jagatguru Sri Candrasekhara Bharati Swaminath (Sri Samkaracarya of Sarada Pitha, Sringeri)
Translator: P. Sankaranarayanan,  Publisher: Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan, Kulapati K.M. Munshi Marg, Bombay 400007, 3rd Edition 1988, Pages 2-6.
Sri Sankara Bhagavatpada has laid out the advaitic philosophy in detail, pointing out that achieving non-duality is the ultimate goal in a life cycle. One achieves clarity of thought and Gnana at this point.
